TI.P: entering a name in the register of traditional specialities guaranteed (Pierekaczewnik (TSG))
correcting Regulation (EC) No 567/2009 entering a name in the register of traditional specialities guaranteed (Pierekaczewnik (TSG))
entering a name in the register of traditional specialities guaranteed (Pierekaczewnik (TSG))

PREAMBLE.PREAMBLE.INIT: THE COMMISSION OF THE EUROPEAN COMMUNITIES,

GR.VISA.VISA: Having regard to the Treaty establishing the European Community,

Having regard to Council Regulation (EC) No 509/2006 of 20 March 2006 on agricultural products and foodstuffs as traditional specialities guaranteed
OJ L 93, 31.3.2006, p. 1., and in particular the first subparagraph of Article 9(4) thereof,

NP.TXT:
In accordance with the first subparagraph of Article 8(2) of Regulation (EC) No 509/2006, and pursuant to Article 19(3) of the same Regulation, the application submitted by Poland to enter the name Pierekaczewnik in the register was published in the Official Journal of the European Union
OJ C 269, 24.10.2008, p. 11..
As no objection under Article 9 of Regulation (EC) No 509/2006 has been received by the Commission, this name should be entered in the register.

When the application for registration was submitted, the protection provided for in Article 13(2) of Regulation (EC) No 509/2006 was also requested. That protection should be granted to the name Pierekaczewnik in so far as, in the absence of objections, it could not be demonstrated that the use of the name is lawful, renowned and economically significant for similar agricultural products or foodstuffs.

ARTICLE.ALINEA: The name contained in the Annex to this Regulation is hereby entered in the register.
The protection provided for in Article 13(2) of Regulation (EC) No 509/2006 shall apply.
This Regulation shall enter into force on the 20th day following its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.

FINAL.P: This Regulation shall be binding in its entirety and directly applicable in all Member States.

CONTENTS.P: Foodstuffs referred to in Annex I to Regulation (EC) No 509/2006:

TXT.HT: Confectionery, bread, pastry, cakes, biscuits and other baker’s wares

GR.SEQ.P: The use of the name is reserved.
